summary: Bubble Bobble entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Bubble Bobble

emulation.emulator: MAME for original arcade comparison only
emulation.notes: Prefer official Arcade Archives for main play; use MAME/original hardware for timing comparison.

primary.why: Bubble Bobble is an arcade original with many ports, but the official Arcade Archives route centers the 1986 arcade version for modern capture. Original hardware/MAME remains the comparison ceiling, especially for timing and two-player behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Arcade Archives with original-style display/options. Record platform, display settings, difficulty/dip-switch equivalents, co-op state, and whether original arcade/MAME timing was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Run a short comparison if documenting arcade authenticity.
secondary.why: The official rerelease is practical, but original arcade hardware is the fidelity benchmark.

secondary.exclusive_content: Some ports have different level counts or platform-specific changes
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if port-variant history matters.
secondary.why: Home ports can differ substantially from the arcade target.

all_releases.fidelity: Many historical conversions with platform-specific differences.
all_releases.reason: skip: port-history only unless a specific variant is requested.
primary: best legal modern route for the arcade original.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Arcade Archives is the main route; original hardware and variant ports are separate comparison targets.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display/filter/assist settings and co-op/input state.
